parts.text: As a fleet technician, my job is to keep our drones and charging equipment in working order. I add new drones to the fleet, retire old ones, set up charging pads at our sites, and take drones out of service for repairs and put them back. I also send drones to charge, and repairs and servicing are carried out by me. Regulators can ask our company to show how our drones have been looked after.
